nights.title: KÄÄRIJÄ
nights.name: Käärijä
nights.extract: Jere Mikael Pöyhönen, known professionally as Käärijä, is a Finnish rapper, singer and songwriter. He represented Finland in the Eurovision Song Contest 2023 with the song "Cha Cha Cha", placing second with 526 points and finishing first in the public vote with 376. His entry topped the charts in Finland, Sweden, Latvia and Lithuania and reached the top ten in thirteen other countries, becoming the first song in Finnish to reach the top ten of the UK Singles Chart.

en.who: Jere Mikael Pöyhönen, known as Käärijä, is a Finnish rapper, singer and songwriter. He represented Finland at the Eurovision Song Contest 2023.
facts: He represented Finland in the Eurovision Song Contest 2023 with the song "Cha Cha Cha", placing second with 526 points and finishing first in the public vote with 376.

His entry topped the charts in Finland, Sweden, Latvia and Lithuania and reached the top ten in thirteen other countries, becoming the first song in Finnish to reach the top ten of the UK Singles Chart.

de.who: Jere Mikael Pöyhönen, bekannt als Käärijä, ist ein finnischer rapper, sänger und songwriter. Er vertrat Finnland 2023 beim Eurovision Song Contest.
facts: Er vertrat Finnland 2023 beim Eurovision Song Contest mit dem lied "Cha Cha Cha" und belegte mit 526 punkten den zweiten platz, während er mit 376 punkten die öffentliche abstimmung gewann.

Sein beitrag erreichte in Finnland, Schweden, Lettland und Litauen die spitze der charts und die top ten in dreizehn weiteren ländern und war damit der erste finnischsprachige song, der es in die top ten der UK Singles Chart schaffte.

tr.who: Jere Mikael Pöyhönen, Käärijä adıyla tanınır; Finli bir rapçi, şarkıcı ve söz yazarıdır. 2023'te Finlandiya'yı Eurovision Şarkı Yarışması'nda temsil etti.
facts: 2023 Eurovision Şarkı Yarışması'nda Finlandiya'yı "Cha Cha Cha" şarkısıyla temsil etti, 526 puanla ikinci oldu ve halk oylamasında 376 puanla birinci oldu.
Parçası Finlandiya, İsveç, Letonya ve Litvanya'da listelerin zirvesine çıktı, diğer on üç ülkede ilk ona girdi ve Fince yazılmış ilk şarkı olarak UK Singles Chart'ın ilk on'una girdi.

nights.title: NONAME
nights.name: Noname
nights.extract: Fatimah Nyeema Warner, known professionally as Noname, is an American rapper. She began rapping and performing slam poetry in 2010, and gained wider recognition in 2013 for her appearance on the track "Lost" from Chance the Rapper's mixtape Acid Rap. She released her debut mixtape, Telefone, in 2016 to critical acclaim. Her debut album, Room 25, was released in 2018 and received further acclaim.

nights.title: Puscifer
nights.name: Puscifer
nights.extract: Puscifer is an American rock group formed in Los Angeles by Maynard James Keenan, lead singer of Tool and A Perfect Circle. Keenan was the only constant member of the band and he considered the project to be his "creative subconscious". Later, frequent collaborators Mat Mitchell and Carina Round became permanent members.

nights.title: Tove Lo: ESTRUS TOUR
nights.name: Tove Lo
nights.extract: Ebba Tove Elsa Nilsson, known professionally as Tove Lo, is a Swedish singer-songwriter. She is known for her raw, grunge-influenced take on pop music. Referring to her autobiographical lyrics, Out called Lo "the saddest girl in Sweden", while Rolling Stone called her "Sweden's darkest pop export".
